name: ‘Uruq Bani Ma’arid
description: ‘Uruq Bani Ma’arid is a desert reserve in southern Saudi Arabia, on the western edge of the Empty Quarter, the largest sea of windblown sand on Earth. Shifting dunes meet limestone plateau cut by hidden valleys that shelter rare plants. It is best known for bringing Arabian oryx back after they vanished from the wild, alongside sand gazelles, in land Bedu herders have long used.
